role: Authenticated ratio-feed publication, durable transaction recovery and separate isolated service implementation; not deployed to production

checks: Fresh target/runtime/report checks and hub simulation immediately before signing
Existing durable SQLite transaction journal commits signed intent before broadcast
Receipt sender, target, attempted hash, exact hub events and receipt-block cached report contents verified before confirmation is stored
Permissionless publication races identified as superseded/no-op feeds instead of claiming an update
Temporary RPC confirmation reads remain pending and retryable; proven semantic mismatches become durably blocked
Six actual local signed publications recover after closing and reopening the journal in observe mode
Duplicate cached reports create no new transaction record
Separate daily verification-value budget rechecked immediately before signing; pending and blocked reserves never age out, replacements cannot change intent or double-count value

Confirmation-time accounting prevents delayed mined publications aging out by submission time; legacy records without confirmation time stay reserved and confirmed reverts release only verification value
Separate explicit isolated configuration and state identity; no inherited stock vault or keeper signing key
Observe mode rejects private keys and recovers persisted publications using only the public relay address
Actual worker cycles publish six authenticated local scenarios and reopen the journal for watch-only recovery
Receipt reconciliation precedes provider and alert requests; provider failure does not block receipt accounting
Confirmed cache runtime, bindings and policy verified independently of provider access; actual adapter round compared against cache-derived conservative ratio
Canonical block rechecks and wall-clock expiry prevent historical or stalled snapshots claiming readiness
Unavailable signed reports continue to invalidate cache; runtime/read failures, missing gas reserve and unverified alert transport prevent publication
Startup and periodic operator transport checks, failed-delivery retries and fixed redacted errors
Authenticated status, separate liveness/readiness endpoints, single-cycle lock, leased volume, signal shutdown and stall exit

Actual standalone Node service starts keyless against wrong-chain loopback RPC, reports live but not ready, rejects unauthorized status requests and a second same-volume process, releases lease on SIGTERM, and restarts with no transactions or secret leakage

Complete status snapshots are published atomically; polling in-flight RPC work retains the last completed snapshot only until its original expiry, while fatal journal failures immediately remove readiness
Explicit expected relay identity hash binds chain, exact publication runtimes and oracle policy without publishing provider credentials
Independently checks snapshot, cache and operator-delivery timestamps instead of trusting the ready flag alone
Redirects refused, status response bounded to 64 KiB, remote incident strings and exceptions not forwarded to alerts
Failed-job exit remains nonzero throughout an outage even when unchanged notifications are deduplicated
Failed notification delivery retries; recovery notification must succeed before outage state is cleared
Watchdog tests its own notification transport on healthy startup and periodically
Actual loopback HTTP endpoint loss is detected; private SQLite outage state survives restart without duplicate notification
Actual isolated-main process uses its normal configuration, Chain, SQLite journal, price client, signer and HTTP alert transport
Fresh loopback Anvil uses generated ephemeral accounts, actual hub/ratio adapter and mock token/verifier fixtures; signed price updates reach confirmed cache
Test-only Node preload routes price and email endpoints to a loopback fixture and blocks nonlocal fetch destinations; test files are not part of the production Docker image
Provider entitlement denial and rejected email requests remove readiness; signed closed-session reports invalidate cache and regular-session recovery restores readiness
Separate actual watchdog process, without relay signing or Pyth credentials, reports unhealthy states, retries notification failures and sends recovery notifications through the local email fixture
Relay gracefully restarts against the same journal and resumes confirmed publication
Abrupt SIGKILL of the relay is detected by the independent watchdog and produces a local outage notification
Generated signing key and provider/status/email credential sentinels never appear in captured process output
Market secondary and corroborated primary reference use the same authenticated ratio adapter
DEX oracle route matches the market atomic liquidation route and nested runtime pins
Hub, verifier, adapter, token identities and policy checked at the deployment verifier's pinned block
Strict manifest schemas reject unexpected fields and malformed policy or approval metadata before serialization
Generated relay configuration is observe-only and watchdog identity matches the actual service parser
Local integration verifies actual ratio, corroborated and TWAP contracts with mock tokens and pools without signing during verification
Provider envelope authenticated through the verifier before preparing hub calldata
Hub, adapter, collateral, USDG and upstream verifier runtimes bound at one canonical block
Adapter token/feed identities and freshness/confidence/publisher policy match explicit configuration
Both cache timestamps inspected; only advancing reports request publication
Fresh signed unavailable reports remain publishable to invalidate old cached good reports
Prepared calldata/value actually submitted to the hub on a disposable local EVM; ratio adapter availability matches each scenario
Duplicate reports request no additional transaction
Wrong pins/bindings, malformed cache, reorg, expired snapshot and rejected hub simulation produce no publication plan
limitations: Integration uses a locally generated provider-signature fixture and mock tokens, not live provider entitlement
Continuous worker and independent watchdog have local coverage; deployed process soak testing, separately scheduled monitoring and actual operator inbox delivery remain unverified
Incoming report quality is not used as adapter readiness; readiness requires confirmed cache reads and expires independently of the worker cycle
Shared gas budgets and separate per-publication and daily verification-value limits are tested locally. Full Robinhood transaction fee economics remain unverified
No production signer loaded, no public-network transaction sent, no market activated
